items.description: Scoopmap.net allows users to view breaking news around the world by leveraging two APIs. Discover hot spots and articles written by high quality newspapers such as the Guardian and New York Times.
Heat map representation and visualization of the top tags for twitter trends. These tags are generated by twopular based on the semantic web service opencalais.

This mashup feeds the semantic web service Calais every five minutes with the most recent tweets behind the current twitter trends in order to determine tags for these trends. With the resulting tag set at your fingertips.
Aggregate news from all around the web, provide related stories, wikinews, tags, wikipedia links, flickr photos , tweets and more...

Newstaggr is a new way for browsing news. It gathers news from sources like Reuters, CNN, New York Times, and BBC, and it uses Calais to semantically tag them and create a tag cloud for 12 categories.

ManiadeCelular.com.br is a community for cell phone and electronics consumers. Ask and answer questions, read tips, reviews and ratings from other members or from the Mobile Mania staff. See releases from all major device manufacturers and carriers.
Rules of thumb in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains an interesting rule of thumb from business, real estate, finance, fashion, sports, and more.
Shared Count is a small utility that will fetch social media shares for a url
A 3D slideshow and photo gallery widget for your Flickr and Smugmug photos. Also available in Facebook, iGoogle, and WordPress plugins
Visitors can use the Street View camera to take a holiday picture. Users can take as many pictures as they like and then submit them for a chance to win a holiday in Majorca.
Advanced music videos search.
Hands Up uses FourSquare to help people find out who is around them. If you are at an event and you see someone else is there, you hold up your phone and wave hello.
A map search for local businesses in Austin. Submit businesses and make comments.
New year's greetings using the Flickr API.
App lets you add random jokes to your Facebook Profile. Jokes come from a Google API-based site.
Worldwide vacation rental listings direct from owners.
Interactive map that presents a balanced view of industrial environmental performance.
The app lets you create an illustrated version of your Foursquare neighborhood, building a visual game on top of FourSquareâ€™s existing technology.

uShip is an online shipping marketplace that connects people with customer-reviewed transport companies. Transporters use uShip to place competing bids to win a customer's business and meet their shipping needs. Partners, affiliates, and third party application developers interact with the uShip marketplace through integrations with the uShip API. With uShip’s API, users can create applications that interface with the uShip platform and build on existing functionality. Documentation is available by registering on the uShip API Developer portal.
Particle Reviews leverages the Rotten tomatoes API and Hulu's unofficial API to provide movie ratings on its site.
